answer: Do not use Musa for urgent jobs, use Chidi. Sallah weekend he disappeared with two hospital runs.
Start the Lister at 4:30pm before PHCN takes light. Neighbours complain after 10. If you wait until light cut, the starter battery dey weak.
Buy Boxer spares from Alhaji at Ladipo stall 14, not Computer Village. Those Taiwan copies no last.
For Ikoyi in the rain send them through Falomo, never Third Mainland. That bridge jam till 4.
Collect cash-on-delivery into the shop POS, not rider personal accounts. One time a rider forget 45k from three COD.
Mrs. Durojaiye wants the parcel left with Grace the housekeeper, never at the gate. Gate man lose one envelope of documents December.
Change engine oil every 1,200 km on the Boxer bikes. If you wait for 2,000 the oil go black and the bike go knock.
Keys for the night locker live in the blue tin behind the kettle, not in the drawer. Drawer dey too obvious.
